ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners are before this Court calling in question registration of a crime in Crime No.0135/2022 for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506B read with Section 34 of the IPC and under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
NC: 2026:KHC:6304 HC-KAR 2.

Heard Sri. Ramesha H.E., learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, Sri. Vinay Mahadevaiah,
learned HCGP appearing for respondent No.1, Sri. Jagadeesha Gowda, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
3.
During the pendency of the proceedings, the parties to the lis have settled the dispute among themselves and have filed joint memo and joint affidavit.

The joint memo and joint affidavit read as follows:
"JOINT MEMO

The parties above named submit as follows:
1. The Respondent No.2 has filed suit for dissolution of Muslim Marriage Act 1939 between Petitioner No.6 and Respondent No.2 herein solemnized on 04.09.2021 at MSJID-E-AQSA, 1st Main, Road, Muneshwaranagara, Sector-6, HSR Layout,
Bengaluru-560068as per Muslim rites and rituals.

2. That the parties entered a khulanama dated 19.05.2025 agreed for separation.

3. The Petitioner No.6 hand over 70.461 grams of 6 gold bangles, 58.140 grams of Lacha-Lacha including big dolar and 27.860 grams of gold in shape of Necklace oxide Neck(Chowkar) gold ornaments to the Respondent No.2.
4.
The Respondent No.2 have agreed to withdraw Crl.Misc.No.177/2022 on the file of the II MMTC, Bengaluru and CC No.36094/2022 on the file 39th ACMM, Bengaluru.
NC: 2026:KHC:6304 HC-KAR 5.
The Petitioner No.6 has also agreed to withdraw Crl. A. No.1390/2024 pending on the file of the Addl. CCH-61 and OS. No.91/2024 on the file of the V-Addl. Family Court Bengaluru.
6. That the petitioners and Respondent No.2 have amicably resolved marriage between Petitioner No.6 and Respondent No.2.

WHEREFORE, it is most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble court be pleased accept the joint memo and affidavit and quash the proceedings under under Section 498(A), 504, 506(B) r/w 34 IPC and section 3 and 4 of D.P. Act, in the interest of justice.
JOINT AFFIDAVIT We, (1) Shafiya Kouser @ Shafiya, Aged about 31 years, W/o Muzamil Sharief.

N, 
(2) Shataj Begum.
A @ Shataj, aged about 65 years, W/o Noor Sharief, (3) Noor Sharief.
M, Aged about 73 years, S/o T.H. Mohamood Sharief, (4) Muzammil Sharief.
M @ Muzammil, Aged about 40 years,

S/o Noor Sharief, (5) N. Fauzia Begum @ Fauziya, Aged about 43 years, W/o. S. Abdul Ahad,
(6) Tanveer Sharief s/o Noor Sharief, Aged about 36 years, R/at No.103, 4th Cross, Near Madina Masjid, HSR Layout 7th Sector, Bengaluru-560068, do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath as follows:
1. We are the petitioners in the above case we know the facts of the case.
2. I am the Respondent No.2 in the above case.
I know the facts of the case.
3. I Petitioner No.6 and Respondent No.2 have compromised before the Family Court at Bengaluru in OS.No.5/2026, same was referred to mediation.
Before the mediation both the parties agreed and compromised between us and also agreed withdraw the allegations against each and other and also family members.
4. We submit that we have a good case on merits.
If this joint affidavit is not accepted, we will put to NC: 2026:KHC:6304 HC-KAR irreparable loss and injury.
If the joint affidavit is allowed no damaged is caused to us.

WHEREFORE, we most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble court be pleased allow to accept the joint affidavit, in the interests of justice and equity."
Smt Shafiya Kouser
